<document name="Purchasing policy.pdf" pages="6">
[Page 1]
Fernwood Labs — Purchasing policy
1. Scope
This policy covers everything Fernwood buys from suppliers: equipment, software
and services. It applies to every team.
Each purchase is requested in Spend and approved before it is ordered.

[Page 2]
2. Matching bills
When goods or services arrive, Spend records the quantity received on each
purchase line.
Every supplier bill is matched to the purchase it pays for and to what we received. If
every line agrees with the purchase and what was received within 2%, the bill is
matched.
When a line doesn't match exactly, Finance (Lena Ortiz) finds the closest purchase
line, notes why, and confirms the match.

[Page 3]
3. Approving and paying
Bills over $2,000 are approved by Krishna before they can be paid. Bills of $2,000
or less are paid once matched.
Nothing is paid until it matches. A received purchase waits at a Billed step until its
bill is paid; then it moves to Billed, and the amount counts against the budget it
belongs to.

[Page 4]
4. Budgets
Each team has a quarterly budget in Tools and budgets. Paid bills count against the
team's budget for the quarter in which they are paid.

[Page 5]
5. Suppliers
New suppliers are added by Finance. We prefer suppliers who bill electronically and
quote a purchase number on each bill.

[Page 6]
6. Records
Bills and receipts are kept for seven years. Questions about this policy go to Lena
Ortiz.
</document>
